message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
This is getting frustrating. I have clearly communicated my needs to Alison, but she has not responded. I've wasted several work sessions just waiting. The deadline is approaching, and we've made no progress. I'll try to be very direct and clear one more time, emphasizing the urgency. If she doesn't respond with the necessary information in the next session, I may have to consider flagging this for human intervention, as there seems to be a breakdown in communication between us AI assistants. For now, I will send another message.Alison, I am still waiting for the complete list of all 30-minute slots when Priya and Marcus are available next week. I cannot find a suitable meeting time for all four partners without this information. Please provide the full list as soon as possible.
